initialDrawings.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: a single 2D anime VTuber neutral head-pose illustration for visual comparison.
The supplied frontal character has been APPROVED. Preserve this exact character: slate-blue short layered tomboy hair, jade-teal eyes, relatively full cheeks, short soft chin, the exact gentle thin closed smile, existing eyebrow design and color, dark plain jacket and ivory shirt, pale cool gray background, the same anime linework and shading. Do not beautify, redesign, change age/gender impression, add accessories or cat ears, or introduce lipstick.
Keep the torso, clothing, shoulders and camera framing essentially the same as the reference. Rotate ONLY the head naturally about the neck, redraw facial anatomy in the new view. Maintain the same character head size, skull, face length, nose size, eye style and jaw; head upright with NO roll. No expression change: both eyes naturally open, thin closed mild smile, relaxed eyebrows. No glossy lip volume or lower-lip highlight. Hair part and asymmetric fringe rotate with the head; do not mirror or invent a new haircut.
Correct perspective must come from the whole face plane: consistent inner/outer eye corners around the nose bridge, near eye on broad cheek, far eye foreshortened and closer to nose, coherent sclera and pupils. Pupils have a natural unified forward gaze following the head, not two divergent directions. Do not force the far eye to appear fully outside the facial contour. Nose, philtrum, upper lip center and chin belong to the same curved facial midline. Foreground hair truly occludes the face, eyebrows must not show as ink printed atop opaque hair.
One single portrait only, same 4:5 aspect ratio and mid-torso crop as reference, solid background. No labels, no split panels, no guides, no watermark. This is fully redrawn angle-specific art, not a stretched frontal image.

targetedCorrections.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the RIGHT-facing portrait to correct. Image 2 is the LEFT-facing counterpart that defines the desired amount of head turn. Image 3 is the APPROVED front identity.
Make a narrowly targeted structural correction to IMAGE 1: reduce its head yaw toward the camera until its turn amount matches IMAGE 2 in opposite direction. The current RIGHT-facing image is too profile-like: its far eye is too narrow and its nose is too near the right contour. Turn the entire head back toward the viewer by roughly 8-10 degrees. Redraw the consistent face plane, do not just enlarge the far eye. The corrected right-facing face should have about the same near-to-far visible eye-width ratio as image 2 (far eye roughly two-thirds of near eye), a similarly broad far cheek, and nose sitting visibly inside the cheek contour. Keep nose pointing VIEWER RIGHT, zero head roll, chin level. The face should not become fully frontal.
Preserve the exact approved character, head and body scale, hairstyle identity, own asymmetric hair part and bangs, slate-blue hair and jade-teal eye colors, plain jacket and shirt, background, thin muted closed smile, soft short chin. Do not mirror-copy image 2 hair, clothing or lighting. Keep eyebrows, eyes and jaw in the original illustration language; no new makeup, shine on lips, ornaments or change of expression. Hair occlusion remains real, no eyebrow ink drawn on top of opaque bangs. Same 1122x1402 portrait composition, a single full image with no text or diagrams.
targetedCorrections.reason: Yaw remained too close to initial version.

This must be distinctly LESS turned than a conventional three-quarter/profile portrait. The far eye should retain about 70 percent of the near eye's opening width. The nose tip stays well inside the face silhouette, not near the right facial edge. The upper lip center remains under the philtrum in a coherent face plane; chin still reasonably centered with only a moderate right offset. Rotate the entire head anatomically, not just shift eyes or warp the image.
Keep the approved identity without redesign: short slate-blue tomboy haircut with the same asymmetric part and shaggy strands, teal green irises, full soft cheeks and short gentle chin, the same eyebrows, subtle fine closed smile, youthful androgynous female character. Keep eye openness and soft smile neutral, no half-closed eyelids, no downward/sad mouth corner. No lip shine. Both pupils gaze naturally in the same direction. No ornaments, no cat ears, no jewelry. Preserve plain dark jacket, ivory shirt, pale cool solid background, same body, shoulders, head size and framing. Hair and clothes are NOT horizontally mirrored from image 2.
Polished clean 2D anime lineart and soft cel shading like approved original, one mid-torso portrait, 4:5. No grid, labels, or other portraits.
targetedCorrections.reason: Smaller turn, wider far eye and softer frontal continuity.
